ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Chel.]
Periodical : anxiety ; shooting in left parietal bone ; stitching, pressing pain in vertex ; evening in bed, tearing pain in left eye ; pressure over umbilicus ; straining and pressing on rectum ; daily at same hour, burning in vagina ; daily, spasm of glottis ; daily, attacks of difficult breathing ; nightly attacks of asthma ; attacks of tightness and pains in chest ; shivering fit daily 3 P. M. ; intermittent, every afternoon ; inflammatory swelling of ankle.
Paroxysms : of pain in kidneys ; of cough ; of rigor in evening ; intermittent in afternoon.
Frequently recurring : heat of face.
Repeatedly : tearing in left eye.
Repeated attacks : of short cough.
Every fortnight : sick headache.
Transient : pains under bones of head and in brain ; biting sting in right eye ; pains in upper maxilla ; in teeth.
Persistent pain : in scrobiculum.
Gradually increasing : supraorbital neuralgia.
Gradually decreasing : secretion of milk.
Going off gradually : stitch in external ear.

TISSUES. [44] [Chel.]
Mind affections, with melancholia, indolence and ill humor.
Inflammatory affections of eyes and meatus of ear.
Neuralgia in and above eyes, affecting principally right side.
Congestion of mucous membranes.
Chronic, gastric and intestinal catarrhs, with decreased secretion of bile, great lassitude and heaviness of limbs, headache and inability to think.
Hepatitis ; jaundice ; fatty liver ; painful enlargement of liver ; gall stones ; bilious condition in general.
Congestion of liver and kidneys.
Alternate diarrhœa and constipation, clay-colored stools.
Catarrh of bladder, with sexual excitation.
Catarrhal inflammation of eyes, nose, larynx and bronchi.
Inflammation of lungs and pleura, particularly right side.
Irregular menstruation, with profuse flow.
Great emaciation, patient so weak as to be unable to walk alone.
Rapid, general emaciation, with loss of appetite. θ Prosopalgia.
Muscular and articular rheumatism ; the least touch on any part of body is exceedingly painful.
In rheumatic and gouty affections of single joints or nerve branches, with frequent headache, attacks of vertigo, dimness of vision.
Excites the whole arterial and capillary system.
Distension of veins ; abdominal plethora ; hemorrhoids.
Ailments accompanied with or without fever, where the functions of the liver are disturbed.
Typhoid and intermittent fevers.
Œdema.
Yellow-grey color of skin.
Vesicular and pustular eruptions.
